incident_text: De fortes inondations touchent un quartier résidentiel de Nabeul. Plusieurs routes sont bloquées et l'eau continue de monter.

result.scene_summary: A street is flooded with brown water, submerging the lower portions of multi-story buildings. The scene appears to be an urban area with European-style architecture under overcast skies.

observations.description: Brown, murky floodwater covers the entire street, reaching up to the bases of buildings.
Several multi-story buildings with varied facades line the flooded street. One building has a sign reading 'AZ' and another has a sign reading 'PROTEZIONE CIVILE'.
